proposal.rationale_html:
Five changes that barely touch each other: the detector, the pause, the notification, the resume and the window arithmetic.

  • Inline would be one session holding all five at once
  • A roadmap is more ceremony than two days of work needs

Brief.html:
Pausing when an account runs out of window

A session that hits its usage limit mid-run fails silently and the conversation looks stalled.
